investor_profile.definition: Represents a single investing entity (typically a VC fund or firm). Captures identity, preferences, constraints, team, activity, and a fit score vs. a specific startup.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this investor profile within your system.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this investor profile record was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this investor profile record was last updated.

version.description: Semantic version or internal schema version of this profile data.

fund_identity.definition: Core identity of the investing firm/fund and high-level positioning.

name.description: Official public name of the fund or firm.

alternative_names.description: List of alternate spellings, abbreviations, or brand names used for the same fund.

logo_url.description: URL to a logo image suitable for display in UI.

fund_structure.description: Legal/economic structure of the fund vehicle or capital pool.

legal_entity_name.description: Registered legal entity name associated with the fund.

aum_usd_estimate.description: Estimated total assets under management in USD across all funds.

fund_size_band.description: Approximate size category of the specific fund this profile refers to.

fund_number.description: Sequence number of the active fund if the firm has multiple (e.g., Fund I, Fund II).

fund_vintage_year.description: Year the current fund started investing (vintage).

status.description: Current high-level status of the fund.

geography_focus.definition: Where the investor is based and the geographies they prefer or avoid.

state_region.description: HQ state or region name where applicable.

offices.description: All physical offices where investment staff may be located.

address_line_2.description: Second line of address (suite, floor, etc.), may be empty.

primary_markets.description: Regions or countries where the fund most actively invests (core focus).

secondary_markets.description: Regions where the fund invests opportunistically but not as a core focus.

excluded_markets.description: Regions or countries that the investor will not invest in for compliance or strategy reasons.

geo_stage_focus.description: Indicates whether the investor is open to emerging vs developed markets.

emerging_markets.description: True if investor actively considers emerging markets.

developed_markets.description: True if investor actively considers developed markets.

investment_stage_focus.definition: Funding stages and how the investor behaves at each stage (check size, ownership, lead preference).

active.description: Whether the investor currently does pre-seed deals.

typical_check_min_usd.description: Minimum typical initial check in USD at pre-seed.

typical_check_max_usd.description: Maximum typical initial check in USD at pre-seed.

ownership_target_min_pct.description: Minimum preferred ownership percentage at pre-seed.

ownership_target_max_pct.description: Maximum preferred ownership percentage at pre-seed.

lead_preference.description: How often the investor leads rounds at this stage.

seed.description: Preferences for seed investments. Same fields as pre_seed.

series_a.description: Preferences for Series A investments. Same fields as pre_seed.

series_b_plus.description: Preferences for Series B and later growth rounds. Same fields as pre_seed.

growth_equity.description: Whether the investor participates in growth equity deals separate from early-stage.

active.description: True if the investor does growth equity / late-stage deals.

special_opportunities.description: Indicates whether the fund runs special situations like secondaries and SPVs.

secondaries.description: True if the investor buys secondary shares.

spvs.description: True if the investor uses SPVs for specific deals.

opportunistic_follow_ons.description: True if they do opportunistic follow-on investments outside normal reserves.

check_size_policy.definition: Overall check size strategy across stages, including follow-ons and reserves.

currency.description: Default currency used for all check size amounts.

initial_check.description: Minimum and maximum initial investment amounts.

min.description: Minimum initial investment across all stages.

max.description: Maximum initial investment across all stages.

follow_on_capacity.description: Range of capital reserved for follow-on checks per company.

reserve_strategy.description: How much the investor reserves vs. initial checks.

reserves_multiple_of_initial.description: Typical ratio of reserved follow-on capital to initial check.

flexibility_flags.description: Indicates how flexible the investor is with their stated check sizes.

can_invest_below_min.description: True if they will occasionally invest below typical minimum.

can_invest_above_max.description: True if they will occasionally invest above typical maximum.

notes.example: Can go outside band for exceptional opportunities.

sector_and_thematic_focus.definition: Industry sectors and structured theses where the investor prefers to invest.

primary_sectors.description: Sectors that represent core focus areas.

sub_sectors.description: More detailed subsectors within this primary sector.

secondary_sectors.description: Sectors the investor considers but that are not core.

excluded_sectors.description: Sectors the investor will not invest in.

thematic_theses.description: Detailed, named theses used for more granular matching.

description.description: Detailed narrative of what this thesis covers.
description.example: Invests in AI-first products that solve deep workflow problems.

stage_emphasis.description: Free-form stage description that best matches this thesis (informational only).

business_model_focus.definition: Preferred business models, pricing models, and deal sizes (ACV).

disfavored_models.description: Business models the investor actively avoids.

pricing_models.description: Monetization models the investor is comfortable with.

acv_preferences.description: Typical annual contract value ranges the investor prefers.

max_acv_usd.description: Maximum typical ACV in USD the investor expects (above may be too enterprise).

notes.example: Prefers meaningful ACV but open to PLG with strong expansion.

sales_motion_preferences.description: Types of go-to-market motions the investor understands and prefers.

product_and_technology_focus.definition: Preferred technology categories, stacks, and defensibility mechanisms.

tech_stack_preferences.description: Preferred or familiar technology stack features.

deep_tech_flags.description: Indicates whether the investor participates in deep tech and which areas.

invests_in_deep_tech.description: True if the investor is comfortable with deep tech companies.

ip_and_defensibility.description: What kinds of defensibility this investor values.

patents_required.description: True if the investor heavily prefers or requires patents.

prefers_strong_ip.description: True if strong intellectual property is a major plus.

network_effects_importance.description: How important network effects are for this investor.

data_moats_importance.description: How important proprietary data moats are.

traction_and_metrics_preferences.definition: Traction levels and metrics thresholds that the investor typically looks for.

pre_revenue.description: Conditions for investing before significant revenue.

acceptable.description: True if the investor is willing to invest pre-revenue.

requirements.description: Required compensating signals for pre-revenue investments.

early_revenue.description: Revenue and KPIs expected at early stage (Seed/Series A).

min_arr_usd.description: Minimum annual recurring revenue usually required.

ideal_arr_range_usd.description: Range of ARR considered ideal at initial investment.

kpi_focus.description: Key metrics this investor uses to evaluate early-stage companies.

growth_stage.description: Expected metrics for more mature companies.

team_and_founder_preferences.definition: Founder backgrounds, team composition, and diversity preferences.

founder_background.description: Value the investor places on certain founder traits.

ex_big_tech.description: Attitude towards experience at big tech companies (FAANG, etc.).

ex_unicorn.description: Attitude towards experience at unicorn startups.

team_composition_preferences.description: Preferred team structure at time of investment.

technical_cofounder_required.description: True if at least one technical cofounder is required.

minimum_full_time_founders.description: Minimum number of full-time cofounders the investor likes to see.

diversity_and_inclusion.description: Information about the investor’s diversity and inclusion commitments.

has_formal_d_and_i_thesis.description: True if the firm has an explicit D&I investment thesis.

public_commitments.description: Publicly stated diversity goals or programs.

activity_and_timing.definition: How active the investor currently is and recent deal activity.

investment_pace.description: Typical number of new deals per year.

deals_per_year_min.description: Lower bound of new deals per year.

deals_per_year_max.description: Upper bound of new deals per year.

current_fundraising_status.description: Whether the investor is actively investing or between funds.

actively_investing.description: True if they are currently deploying capital.

fundraising_new_fund.description: True if the investor is currently raising a new fund.

slowdown_reason.description: Optional note explaining any slowdown in pace.

last_investment_date.description: Date of the last publicly known investment.

recent_relevant_deals.description: Recent deals relevant to a given startup (by sector/geo/stage).

sector.description: High-level sector of the portfolio company.

decision_process.definition: How the investor makes decisions, timeframes, and governance expectations.

typical_timeline_days.description: Approximate time from first meeting to term sheet.

min.description: Fastest realistic decision time in days.

max.description: Slowest realistic decision time in days.

process_steps.description: Ordered list of high-level steps in the investment process.

lead_or_follow.description: Whether the investor prefers to lead, follow, or both.

can_lead.description: True if they are able to lead rounds.

prefers_to_lead.description: True if they typically try to lead when they invest.

can_follow.description: True if they are willing to be a follower or co-investor.

max_pct.description: Maximum ownership they would typically hold.

board_seat_policy.description: When the investor expects board or observer roles.

requires_board_seat_if_lead.description: True if a board seat is usually required when leading.

observer_rights_if_follow.description: True if observer rights are usually requested when following.

contact_and_relationships.definition: Contact details, intro preferences, and connection strength.

generic_email.description: General contact or dealflow email inbox.

application_form_url.description: Link to apply or submit a pitch (if available).

phone_number.description: Public phone number if the firm lists one.

email_format.description: Canonical pattern for firm email addresses.

examples.description: Concrete examples of emails to validate the pattern.

social_links.description: Official social media profiles for the firm.

twitter.description: Firm Twitter/X profile URL, if present.

blog.description: Firm blog or insights content URL.

warm_intro_preferences.description: Preferred warm introduction sources and cold outreach stance.

preferred_intro_sources.description: Types of people or entities the firm prefers intros from.

cold_email_policy.description: Openness and guidance regarding cold emails.

accepts_cold_emails.description: True if cold emails are welcomed or at least considered.

best_targets.description: Recommended roles or contacts for cold outreach.

notes.description: Additional guidance for effective cold outreach.
notes.example: Cold emails are considered when highly tailored.

relationship_metadata.description: User-specific metadata about the relationship to this investor.

connection_strength_score.description: Heuristic score 0–1 representing closeness of relationship.

notes.example: Met partner at conference; warm to AI workflows.

existing_intros.description: Potential or completed warm intro paths.

from_name.description: Name of person who can provide an intro.

date.description: Date when intro was offered or made.

notes.example: Offered to intro for relevant AI infra deals.

partners_and_team.definition: Individual partners and investment team members at the firm.

partners.description: General partners or partners with decision-making authority.

title.description: Official title (e.g., General Partner, Managing Partner).

email.description: Direct email address of the partner.

twitter_url.description: Partner's Twitter/X profile URL, if any.

location.description: Primary working location of the partner.

city.description: City where the partner is primarily based.

country.description: Country where the partner is primarily based.

personal_thesis.description: Topics, sectors, or theses this partner focuses on.

check_size_ownership.description: Typical check size this partner leads personally.

board_seat_preference.description: Partner's preference for taking board seats.

portfolio_examples.description: Representative portfolio companies led by this partner.

warm_introduction_routes.description: Best types of people for warm intros to this partner.

investment_team.description: Principals, associates, analysts, or platform roles relevant to sourcing.

focus.description: Sectors, stages, or themes this person covers.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile of this team member.

fit_scoring.definition: Machine-generated and qualitative fit between this investor and a specific startup.

overall_fit_score.description: Single 0–1 score summarizing fit; higher is better.

fit_dimensions.description: Dimension-specific fit scores for detailed analysis.

stage_fit_score.description: Fit score for stage (pre-seed, seed, etc.).

check_size_fit_score.description: Fit score for desired check size vs investor ranges.

business_model_fit_score.description: Fit score for business model alignment.

traction_fit_score.description: Fit score for traction vs investor expectations.

founder_background_fit_score.description: Fit score for team traits vs preferences.

qualitative_fit_notes.description: Narrative explanation of why this investor is a good or poor fit.
qualitative_fit_notes.example: Strong fit for US-based B2B SaaS seed/Series A with AI angle.

red_flags.description: Non-fatal but concerning issues for this match, in code or free-text form.

deal_blockers.description: Hard blockers that make an investment nearly impossible.

outreach_strategy_model.definition: System’s recommended outreach playbook for this investor.

priority_rank.description: Relative priority of this investor among all candidates (1 = highest).

ideal_intro_personas.description: Types of people best suited to introduce you to this investor.

suggested_angle.description: Concise narrative angle that should resonate with this investor.
suggested_angle.example: AI-native workflow automation for enterprise teams; maps to Jane Doe's thesis on AI infra.

email_subject_templates.description: Subject-line templates tailored to this investor.
example: Seed round: AI-native [category] for [ICP] – intro via [mutual_contact]
[Mutual_contact] suggested I reach out – [company] x Sequoia

follow_up_cadence_days.description: Recommended days after initial outreach for each follow-up touch.

notes.description: Additional tactical notes (e.g., when to send materials, how detailed to be).
notes.example: Emphasize traction, design partners, and technical depth of founding team.

source_and_quality.definition: Provenance of this data and confidence levels.

data_sources.description: Sources from which data was obtained.

last_verified_at.description: Last time key data points for this profile were validated.

confidence_score.description: 0–1 heuristic confidence in accuracy and freshness of this profile.

missing_fields.description: List of important fields known to be missing or incomplete.

custom_tags.definition: Free-form tags used for filtering and classification of investors.
custom_tags.description: Arbitrary tags describing the investor (tiering, special attributes, etc.).
